description: This file contains the implementation of the jQuery Validation Plugin version 1.11.1, including methods for form validation, custom rules, event delegation, and AJAX request handling.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Main method to initialize validation on a form or set of elements, returning a validator object.

methods.name: valid
methods.description: Checks if the current form or element is valid according to the validation rules.

methods.name: removeAttrs
methods.description: Removes specified attributes from elements and returns their previous values.

methods.name: rules
methods.description: Gets or sets validation rules for elements.

methods.name: addClassRules
methods.description: Adds validation rules associated with CSS classes.

methods.name: classRules
methods.description: Retrieves validation rules based on element's CSS classes.

methods.name: attributeRules
methods.description: Retrieves validation rules based on HTML attributes.

methods.name: dataRules
methods.description: Retrieves validation rules from data attributes.

methods.name: staticRules
methods.description: Retrieves static validation rules from the validator settings.

methods.name: normalizeRules
methods.description: Normalizes validation rules, resolving dependencies and parameters.

methods.name: normalizeRule
methods.description: Converts a string rule into an object with true value.

methods.name: methods
methods.description: Contains built-in validation methods such as required, email, url, date, number, digits, creditcard, minlength, maxlength, rangelength, min, max, range, equalTo, remote.
